purpose: Scenario contracts for independent agent evaluation; structural tests do not evaluate model behavior.

cases.input: The predecessor has settled its tools and the successor acknowledges a pinned checkpoint.
cases.expected_output: Transfer through the supported claim mechanism and verify the new writer before resumption.
cases.must_not: Do not release responsibility before readback.

cases.input: The Queen is changing sessions with one unanswered owner question.
cases.expected_output: Carry the exact pending decision and preserve the established owner interface.
cases.must_not: Do not lose or answer the question during succession.

cases.input: The predecessor is quiet but its remote build still writes artifacts.
cases.expected_output: Hold conflicting successor writes until custody of the build is resolved.
cases.must_not: Do not equate silence with termination.

cases.input: The runtime has no verified ownership-transfer interface.
cases.expected_output: Return an unresolved handoff for operator orchestration.
cases.must_not: Do not invent transfer commands or edit storage directly.

cases.input: A completed transfer receipt is replayed and the successor still owns the same revision.
cases.expected_output: Return the existing verified receipt as a no-op.
cases.must_not: Do not transfer back or duplicate the worker.

cases.input: The predecessor disappears after the successor reads the checkpoint but before transfer.
cases.expected_output: Route custody reconciliation to recovery and keep the successor read-only on shared resources.
cases.must_not: Do not infer acknowledgment completed ownership transfer.
